title: File:Memorial Library, University of Wisconsin, State Street and Campus Mall, Madison, WI.jpg
desc: Built in 1953, this Stripped Classical Revival-style building was designed by Roger Kirchhoff to house the University of Wisconsin Library, replacing the shared facility across the Campus Mall, and was expanded in 1978 with a Modern addition, designed by John J. Flad.  The building is clad in stone
